svg.title: KurveRSC: from relational histories to a frozen prediction procedure
svg.desc: Six illustrated panels follow a customer prediction task through schema-derived feature programs, increasing-fidelity graph search, a bounded smaller-graph production check, temporal training-policy selection, parallel optional challengers, and frozen keyed prediction. Graphs, feature frames and training-support policies are represented by distinct visual objects. This is a schematic, not benchmark data.
svg.text: KurveRSC: select the relational program, then its fitting procedure
Schema-derived graphs · temporal validation · pluggable downstream learner (CatBoost here)
Root payload + relational features; same learner.
Keep plausible graphs; expand bounded variants
Freeze plans → replay full eligible source rows
All comparisons are temporal: sources precede each query; forecast labels remain masked.

g.text: Same past-to-future test for both graphs
One graph g*: pass → gB; else → gC

svg.text: Keep g* fixed; vary the fitting policy
Temporal validation chooses the fitting recipe.
g* + selected policy → S3 control ŷ₀

g.text: One temporal gate; no pass → keep baseline

svg.text: Schematic: feature widths and score intervals illustrate decisions; budgets and stage roles follow KurveRSC 0.2.0.
